title: What percent of you guys have seen Stranger Things?
content: I’ve had mall world dreams but I think they all occurred after season two of Stranger Things. It takes place in a mall, it’s a small group of childhood friends (a common theme of my dreams), a 80’s kind of neon aesthetic (a common theme here), a shared enemy, an atmosphere teeming with emotion. It seems like it could be the source of our shared dreams. Honestly I don’t remember when I had my first mall world dream. It could have been before season two of Stranger Things but I think it’s worth exploring.
